# FONY

> FONY is a browser-based music player combining free 24/7 internet radio streaming with Web3 NFT audio playback, an AI console, and discovery/customization tools — all in a single static web app, no account or subscription required.

FONY streams dozens of genre-based internet radio stations directly in the browser, with live now-playing metadata, automatic stall recovery, shareable deep links (e.g. `fony.fun/techno` auto-plays that genre), and support for adding custom M3U playlists. It also lets users connect a wallet to stream audio from a curated set of NFT collections, includes an in-app AI chat console (track facts, mood-based station matching, Discogs lookups, genre-tuned equalizer presets), and offers theming, favorites, and a personal track collection.

The main app at the root URL is a JavaScript single-page player; the pages below are static, human- and AI-readable reference content about the product and the genres it streams.

## About

- [About FONY — features, FAQ, and how it works](https://fony.fun/about.html)

## Genre Reference (Fonypedia)

A standalone music genre encyclopedia — one static page per genre with characteristic instruments, dominant styles, and notable artists by era, each linking directly into the matching live station in the player.

- [Fonypedia — full genre index](https://fony.fun/fonypedia/index.html)
